item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(req,pol,expected):\\n    r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n    got=evaluate(req,pol)\\n    assert got==expected,(req,got,expected)\\n    assert req==r0 and pol==p0, 'inputs mutated'\\n    assert list(got)==['ok','value','reason']\\n\\np={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'}},'retry_limit':2}\\ncheck({'from':'a','to':'b'},p,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})\\ncheck({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})\\ncheck({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'bad','attempts':99},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})\\nfor a in (0,1): check({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':a},p,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})\\nfor a in (-1,2,True,False,1.0,'1',None): check({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':a},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\nreqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in reqs]\\nprint('all checks passed:',len(reqs)+11)\"]}"}
